title: Lesson 9 - Data 360 Standard Permission Sets and Permission Set Licenses
description: Configure Data 360 permissions, permission sets, and organization-wide settings, focused on assigning the standard Data 360 permission sets, understanding permission set licenses, and choosing between standard and cloned custom sets.

questions.question: An admin assigns the Data Cloud User permission set to a business analyst, but the analyst reports they cannot open Data Cloud Setup. What is the reason?
options: The analyst also needs the System Administrator profile
Data Cloud User grants view-only access and no Data Cloud Setup access
The analyst's permission set license expired overnight
Data Cloud User requires the Modify All Data permission
questions.explanation: Data Cloud User is a view-only set with no Data Cloud Setup access, so it cannot open the admin console. The strongest distractor, requiring the System Administrator profile, is wrong because the analyst was never meant to administrate; the correct set for build work is Data Cloud Architect.

questions.question: An architect must give a developer every Data 360 capability but keep them out of broad Salesforce Setup changes. What is the best approach?
options: Assign Data Cloud Architect exactly as shipped
Clone Data Cloud Architect and remove the Customize Application permission before assigning
Create a brand new permission set from scratch
questions.explanation: Data Cloud Architect grants full Data 360 access but also bundles Customize Application, so cloning it and stripping that one permission preserves the capability while limiting Setup reach. Assigning it as shipped is the strongest distractor and is wrong because it hands over broad Setup customization.

questions.question: An org moved from a Customer Data Platform license to a Data Cloud license and users lost Data 360 access. What must the admin do?
options: Nothing, access carries over with the license
Assign the permission sets associated with the new Data Cloud license
Grant the System Administrator profile to everyone
questions.explanation: The old Customer Data Platform permission sets stop granting Data 360 access after the license change, so the new Data Cloud permission sets must be assigned, ideally in bulk with User Access Policies. Granting System Administrator to everyone is the strongest distractor and is wrong because it over-grants and bypasses the intended permission model.
